evidence.title: AtlasEdge Accelerates German Growth with Second Leverkusen Data Centre
evidence.excerpt: AtlasEdge reports that construction of the adjacent LEV002 facility in Leverkusen began in February 2026 and gives a future Q2 2027 readiness schedule.
